LOCATION

New York, NY, USA
(Hybrid work – required to be in office 2–3 days/week)



JOB DESCRIPTION

At Interplay, we invest, coach, and cofound companies. We're building a next-generation AI operations platform designed to transform how our firm and portfolio companies operate. We're looking for a Junior Forward Deployed Engineer to embed directly with our business lines (Ventures, Accelerator, Studio, and Ascend) and translate real operational needs into working software, fast. You'll sit next to the end user, ship quickly, and iterate in the room rather than over a spec doc.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Embed with business line teams to understand their workflows firsthand.

 - Rapidly prototype and ship internal tools, integrations, and AI-powered features.

 - Translate ambiguous, real-world problems into scoped technical solutions.

 - Write production code across frontend, backend, and APIs.

 - Integrate LLM-powered automation into day-to-day workflows.

 - Demo early, gather feedback in person, and ship again.

 - Document what you build and hand off durable solutions as needs stabilize.
   
   

WHO YOU ARE

 - A builder with 0–2 years of engineering experience, hungry to learn fast in a high-ownership environment.

 - Energized by ambiguity and comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders.

 - Scrappy — you'd rather ship a rough version today than a polished one next month.

 - Curious about AI and LLM tooling and eager to apply it to real problems.

 - A strong communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs simply.

 - Low ego, coachable, and outcome-driven.
   
   

REQUIRED SKILLS

 - 0–2 years in software engineering (internships and strong personal projects count).

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Working proficiency across at least one modern frontend and backend stack.

 - Track record of shipping applications end to end.

 - Solid understanding of APIs and databases (SQL).

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - U.S. work authorization.
   
   

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Next.js, Vercel, and Supabase.

 - Strong Python background.

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini).

 - Proficient in Claude Code / Cursor / Other AI Enabled Coding tools

 - Plus (Experience building agents)
   
   

COMPENSATION

$85–100k base salary, commensurate with experience
Competitive health benefits

Role Overview
We are seeking a resourceful hands-on Embedded Software Engineer to build high-reliability real-time systems. You will operate at the intersection of hardware and software, writing Modern C++ for Linux targets while leveraging Python for test automation. This is a hardware heavy role; you should be comfortable bringing up boards, debugging signals with an oscilloscope, and writing defensive code that ensures safety and performance.
Key Responsibilities
Embedded Development: Write efficient, robust C++ for Embedded Linux platforms. You know when to follow the rules and when to think laterally to squeeze out performance.
Agile Execution : Work within an agile sprint driven framework to iterate quickly with short planning and development cycles.
Hardware Interface: Write drivers and manage communications over common interlinks (Examples: CAN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, UART). You aren't afraid to reverse-engineer a protocol or write a custom driver if the standard one fails.
Deep-Dive Debugging: Get your hands dirty with hardware integration and bring-up. You will troubleshoot signal integrity and protocol weirdness using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or network sniffers.
Resilient Design: Design software with a safety-first mindset. You anticipate edge cases and write defensive code that ensures deterministic behavior, even when assumptions are violated or the hardware does something unexpected.
Qualifications
Experience: 2–5 years of embedded software engineering
Core Languages: Strong proficiency in modern C++ (11/14/17/20) for production code. Fluency in Python and Bash for data manipulation, testing, and prototyping.
Mindset: You are comfortable working with ambiguity. You don’t need a manual for everything; you can figure out how things work (or why they don't) and devise creative workarounds to keep the project moving.
OS: Solid understanding of Embedded Linux (kernel/user-space interactions) and how to manipulate it via the shell.
Real-Time: Experience with real-time constraints and resource constrained hardware.
Build Systems: Familiarity with Yocto, GTest, CMake, ansible is a plus.
